messages.subject: single units for exon array
parts:
Hi.

I found what my previous error was when it gets to calculating
weights for the exon chip with the brainarray CDF. It has to do with
the fact that the brainarray build has a whole bunch of single-probe
units (and I think these are the genomic or anti-genomic background
probes) that do not get unwrapped properly in the .subset2(.subset2
(unit)) deconstruction of the readUnits list.

Personally, the weights aren't that important for this stage, I think
I will just not calculate weights on this chip type. I just thought
I would mention it as a word of caution.


The error from before:
---------
20070624 23:11:45| Reading residuals unit by unit for 33 arrays...done
20070624 23:11:45| Calculating weights...
Error in log(x, base) : Non-numeric argument to mathematical function
20070624 23:11:45| Calculating weights...done
20070624 23:11:45| Extracting unit data...done
20070624 23:11:45|Calculating PLM weights...done
Execution halted
---------

Cheers,
Mark
